profile.name: Asuka
profile.overview: Asuka Kazama is a solid defensive character that is a good pick for beginner players looking to punish their opponent's habits. Her basic combos are straightforward, and she has good keep-out tools, safe counter hit launchers, and good panic buttons that are all fairly easy to understand and use.
profile.playstyle: Defensive and patient. Keep the opponent out with safe mids, make them whiff with sidesteps and spacing, then punish hard. Her reversal (b+1+3) and counter-hit tools punish people who press too much. Her offence is risky, so let the opponent come to you.
strengths: Good arsenal of panic moves and heat engagers to close rounds and turn the tide
Strong keepout with mid-range pokes and sabakis
Plethora of powerful and relatively safe counter hit tools
Evasive tools and parries make her scary to approach
Many strings that can be either delayed to punish the opponent's retaliation or canceled to take advantage of their hesitation to retaliate
Naniwa Gusto changes the properties on certain moves in ways that boost Asuka's strengths while also giving her access to stronger offensive opportunities
Damaging attacks, potent okizeme, and various ways to access Naniwa Gusto mean that this character's hits can quickly snowball into a lot of damage if the opponent is not careful approaching her
weaknesses: No plus jab, generally risky and flawed offense
Subpar backdash, forcing her to rely more on sidesteps and spacing traps to make things whiff
Non-generic standing lows are slow and can be risky, low reward, or both unless her opponent is at the wall

stances.name: Naniwa Gusto
stances.entry: Heat activation, or f+2 then 1 on hit
stances.note: A power-up: NWG.f,F+1+2 and NWG.f,f,F+1+2 get stronger, and NWG.f,f,F+1+2 is +7 on block. Wavu: in Heat she can always use it.

stances.name: Destabilizer
stances.note: A stance after her f+1+3 throw-like move. DST.2 is a Heat Engager. Leaving it with no input is -3.

sources.name: Wavu Wiki
sources.note: Community-maintained frame data. Values can lag behind the latest patch; verify in Practice mode frame display.

keyMoves.purpose: Fast interrupt and the start of her i10 punish (1,2).
keyMoves.use: Close range when you need the fastest answer.
keyMoves.avoid: Expecting to keep the turn: Wavu notes she has no plus jab.
keyMoves.gamePlan: Use it to interrupt, not to pressure.

keyMoves.use: To stop the opponent ducking and to poke at mid range.
keyMoves.gamePlan: Your main way to make the opponent respect mids.

keyMoves.summary: Rising Palm: i15 launch on standing opponents, -6 on block.
keyMoves.purpose: Her i15 launch punisher and a safe whiff punisher.
keyMoves.use: Punish -15 moves; whiff punish at close range.
keyMoves.avoid: Expecting it to launch crouchers: on crouch hit it is only +5s.
keyMoves.counterplay: Duck it when you expect it.
keyMoves.gamePlan: A safe launcher: the heart of her punish game.

keyMoves.summary: Inner Strength: i16 mid launcher, -9 on block.
keyMoves.use: After blocking moves that are -16 or worse.
keyMoves.avoid: Raw in neutral: -9 hands over the turn.
keyMoves.gamePlan: Use it when df+2 is too short.

keyMoves.summary: Moon Scent: i18 while-standing tornado, -16 on block.
keyMoves.use: After blocking lows that are -18 or worse.
keyMoves.gamePlan: The payoff for blocking big lows.

keyMoves.purpose: Fastest while-standing punisher and a crouching mid check.
keyMoves.use: After blocking -11 lows; to poke from crouch.

keyMoves.summary: i15 knee, launches on counter hit (+56a), -7 on block.
keyMoves.use: When you expect the opponent to press.
keyMoves.avoid: Expecting damage on normal hit: only +8.
keyMoves.gamePlan: Her best reward against people who mash after blocking.

keyMoves.summary: i11 high kick, launches on counter hit (+32a).
keyMoves.purpose: A fast high that launches on CH.
keyMoves.afterBlock: -9: careful, punishable by i9 or faster only.
keyMoves.gamePlan: A fast interrupt with a big reward.

keyMoves.summary: i20 low, -12 on block, +14g on counter hit.
keyMoves.counterplay: Block low, punish with an i12 or faster move.

keyMoves.summary: Heaven's Hammer: i18 mid Heat Engager, -4c on block.
keyMoves.purpose: A safe mid that starts Heat and spikes.
keyMoves.use: As a safe Heat start or to hit crouching opponents.

keyMoves.summary: Leaping Spin Kick: i20 high, -3 on block, launches (+66a).
keyMoves.purpose: A long-range launcher that is safe on block.
keyMoves.use: Whiff punish at range or to close distance.

keyMoves.summary: Reversal: reverses high or mid attacks.
keyMoves.use: As a read when the opponent will press a high or mid.
keyMoves.counterplay: Throw or low her when you expect it.
keyMoves.gamePlan: A strong tool against impatient opponents.

keyMoves.summary: Katanuki: i12 throw, break with 1 or 2, side switch.
keyMoves.purpose: Her generic throw with a side switch.
keyMoves.use: Against opponents who block a lot.
keyMoves.avoid: When they are ready to break.
keyMoves.gamePlan: Use it to put opponents near the wall with the side switch.

combos.name: Launch BnB: f,F+2,3 db1,4 T!
combos.situation: After a standing df+2 launch (or 1+2, f+2 per Wavu staples).
mistakes: Doing db+1 too slowly after f,F+2,3: keep the rhythm.
